evidence.note: Femi Koleoso, drums; produced by Ezra Collective; released 27 September 2024.

drum_performances.name: Femi Koleoso
drum_performances.why_it_matters: The album after the Mercury Prize: Afrobeat and dance-floor grooves, with Fela's Expensive Shit and Ajala, recorded in Lagos.

drums.description: Fela Kuti's Expensive Shit (1975) over four on the floor: eighths on the hat, the snare on 1, the "a" of 1, the "and" of 2 and of 3 and the "e" of 4; a bridge with the kick in threes under a cowbell; ride-bell sections, one ghosted. At 135.

transcriptions.note: Machine-made (aiGenerated); tempo and form match the record

drums.description: Recorded in Lagos: the hat opened with the snare figure over four on the floor at 155, then closed on the beat and opened on the "and"; the intro a hit on the 1.

transcriptions.note: Machine-made (aiGenerated); tempo and form match the record

tracks.title: God Gave Me Feet for Dancing

drums.description: With Yazmin Lacey: sixteenths on the hat over four on the floor, the snare or rim on the "a" of 1 and the "and" of 2, a hatless snare figure, crashes on the off-beats. At 118.

transcriptions.note: Human tab at 115; the record is 118

drums.description: With Olivia Dean: the hat on the "and"s, rim clicks on the "a" of 1 and of 2, on 4 and its "a", the kick on 1, 3 and its "and"; four on the floor in the outro. At 103.
